$comment: The changelog entry for Smart Scheduling (docs/changelog.md), written by the rollout-changelog-writer agent from input/smart-scheduling/feature.md and the brief.
title: Smart Scheduling: book meetings inside the conversation
summary: You can now book meetings without leaving the text thread. Offer open times from your team's calendars in one click, and the meeting is created, confirmed and reminded automatically.

image.alt: A text conversation where the customer picks one of three suggested meeting times

sections.title: Offer open times in the thread
sections.body: Click Suggest times in the composer to add three open slots to your reply. Customers answer with a number or a tap.

sections.title: What's included
bullets: Google and Microsoft calendars, with working hours, buffers and round-robin
Confirmations, plus reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before
Meeting types and booking questions for each inbox
